# Rising Lion: vanilla's add_holy_site_fallback_special_district_slot_effect (00_religion_effects.txt), overridden by key: the
# Mesopotamian and Aramean pagan holy sites take our ziggurat and classical temple districts (search "Rising Lion").
# Generated by tools/make_holy_site_slot_override.py; rerun after every vanilla update.

add_holy_site_fallback_special_district_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_special_district_slot = no
		}
		# Rising Lion: the old faith's holy sites take a ziggurat
		if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { this = faith:mesopotamian_pagan } }
			add_special_district_slot = jip_holy_site_ziggurat_01_district
		}
		# Rising Lion: Arameanism's take a classical temple
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { this = faith:aramean_pagan } }
			add_special_district_slot = jip_holy_site_classical_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = religion:islam_religion } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_mosque_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = religion:christianity_religion } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_cathedral_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = religion:zoroastrianism_religion } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_fire_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = religion:buddhism_religion } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_buddhist_grand_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = religion:shintoism_religion } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_japanese_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				$FAITH$ = {
					OR = {
						religion = religion:taoism_religion
						religion = religion:confucianism_religion
					}
				}
			}
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_chinese_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				$FAITH$ = {
					religion = {
						OR = {
							this = religion:hinduism_religion
							this = religion:jainism_religion
							this = religion:tani_religion
							this = religion:bon_religion
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_indian_grand_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				$FAITH$ = {
					religion = {
						OR = {
							this = religion:satsana_phi_religion
							this = religion:dayawism_religion
							this = religion:hantuism_religion
							this = religion:kaharingan_religion
							this = religion:tolotang_religion
							this = religion:aluk_religion
							this = religion:dab_qhuas_religion
							this = religion:biliku_religion
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_se_asia_pagan_temple_01_district
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { $FAITH$ = { religion = { is_in_family = rf_pagan } } }
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_pagan_grand_temple_01_district
		}
		else = {
			add_special_district_slot = holy_site_other_grand_temple_01_district
		}
	}
}
